assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-regional-clinic-v1.png` (2400 x 1500): a small single-storey brick clinic on a quiet regional-town main street in daylight: three concrete steps up to a glass door and no ramp; a blank rectangular sign panel above the door (no text); a blank white board beside the door where opening hours would go; a brochure rack visible inside the front window; at the kerb, a bus stop pole with an empty timetable frame; a footpath and a parked bicycle. No people, no text, no logos.
